o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish وار (var), from Proto-Turkic *bār. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰉𐰺 (bar).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوكرتمك (ögrätmäk). Cognate with Turkish öğretmek (“to teach”) and Turkish öğrenmek (“to learn”).
Internationalism. Likely via Russian диктатура (diktatura), from Latin dictatura.
From Old Anatolian Turkish كرچك (gẹrçek, “true”), from Proto-Turkic *kẹrtüček, from Proto-Turkic *kẹrtü (“true, truth”).
